title: Manual Resolution first-class substrate
rationale: Identity/context-aware Manual Resolution substrate is present. MATCH is limited to the first-class Resolution substrate and does not claim that newly clarified Choice Authority, canonical effect-actor, privacy-preserving signal, or R6 presentation semantics are implemented.
nextAction: Preserve the substrate. M3 now exposes Choice Authority and effect-granted-action verification obligations without claiming those behaviors are implemented; later product work must satisfy them.
